240-4785-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-4785-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

394-586-864-3125-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-586-864-3125-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2324-2415-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

4551-6733-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
4551-6733-8089.description:
Activate Arco-Flagellant by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1981-2415-3967-4268.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3967-4268.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3197-3263-6824-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-3263-6824-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5003-5868.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Frost Fair Lure Fish, adding {C}{C}.
When Frost Fair Lure Fish dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Frost Fair Lure Fish from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Frost Fair Lure Fish enters, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Fish creature tokens and two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1491-3755-6218-7741.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

6798-6872-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
6798-6872-7690--165.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1368-2079-3755-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2079-3755-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

586-2511-5258-5618-7646.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1069-2457-4460-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-4460-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

1170-1328-2105-4742.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1328-2105-4742.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

877-1374-4668-5910.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
877-1374-4668-5910.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Heliod and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

1409-3128-5921.description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve both Skullport Merchant triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-4779-6972.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

3809-4682-5140-5184.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
3809-4682-5140-5184.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create two Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Repeat.
3809-4682-5140-5184.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

431-1308-4365-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-4365-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

3525-4131-4720-6657.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Basalt Monolith's ability three times.
Resolve a copy of Basalt Monolith's ability, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Gogo.
Repeat from step 3.

1445-2921-4871-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2921-4871-5631.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

186-2060-3334-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
186-2060-3334-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2713-4499-5421.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Redcap Thief.
When Redcap Thief enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

837-1283-2440-3012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Humans and/or Monks.
837-1283-2440-3012.description:
Activate Seal of Removal by sacrificing it, returning Lotus-Eye Mystics to your hand.
Cast Lotus-Eye Mystics by paying {4}.
When Lotus-Eye Mystics enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Lotus-Eye Mystics trigger, returning Seal of Removal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {5}.
Cast Seal of Removal by paying {1}.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Humans and/or Monks, this combo nets infinite mana.

245-2034-4365.description:
Activate Marneus by paying {6}, creating four creature tokens due to Mondrak.
When the tokens enter, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1887-1961-2793-5089.description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Throne of Geth ability, putting two loyalty counters on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

791-2290-2445.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
791-2290-2445.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

1819-2607-3244.notablePrerequisites: You have twenty or more creature cards in library and/or graveyard.
1819-2607-3244.description:
Cast Morality Shift.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card leaving and entering your graveyard, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.

618-1228-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Kiki-Jiki.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
618-1228-2178.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Goblin Sharpshooter with haste.
Activate the nontoken Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the token Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
The token dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Kiki-Jiki and Goblin Sharpshooter.
Resolve both triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki and Goblin Sharpshooter.
Repeat.
